changes.what: Sets migrations_dir in wrangler.example.toml to a new directory with worker/schema.sql (a symlink) and one admin row
changes.why: The project creates its D1 schema and first admin through GitHub Actions and `wrangler d1 execute`. The row is what `npm run admin:bootstrap` generates, with a local-only password.

knownFailures.step: two sockets stay open while the room hibernates, and a message wakes it
knownFailures.note: WebSocket hibernation is not available on Rivet 3. Orange emulates it: it drops the idle object and keeps its sockets open, but the Rivet actor does not sleep while a socket is open. This step waits for every actor to sleep, so it fails with: Some actor was still awake.
